title: Lowe’s grows alongside one of Texas’ fastest-growing communities
summary: Lowe’s grows alongside one of Texas’ fastest-growing communities
body_markdown:
As one of the fastest-growing areas in the country welcomes new neighbors and new homes, Lowe’s is growing with it.


In November, Lowe’s opened its newest store in Willis, the company’s fifth new Texas location in 2026, meeting the needs of a growing Montgomery County community with more than 100 new jobs and a commitment to becoming part of the community it serves.


Leading the new store is Jacob King, who has spent 16 years with Lowe’s and is opening his first new location as store manager.


“There’s a lot of growth happening around Willis, but it still has that close-knit community feel,” King said. “We want to be the kind of store that people can count on, whether they’re tackling a project at home, running a business, or just need some advice.”
